CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERONLINEBANKINGUSERPASSWORDSTATUS_RIB
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
AS(
SELECT
     BRC.CORP_USER AS CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
    ,BRC.R_MOD_TIME AS [Timestamp]
    ,BRC.PWD_ENABLED_FLAG AS PasswordEnabledIndicator
    ,BRC.FORCE_TXN_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FLG AS ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
    ,BRC.FORCE_PWD_CHANGE_FLG AS ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
    ,BRC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BRC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BRCD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.RIB_CORPORATEUSER_DELTA BRCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.RIB_CORPORATEUSER BRC ON BRC.CORP_USER = BRCD.CORP_USER AND BRC.BANK_ID = BRCD.BANK_ID AND BRC.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
 CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
)) HASHROW, CustomerOnlineBankingUserId, FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
 CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
)) HASHROW, CustomerOnlineBankingUserId, FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId, TGT.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId) AS CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId = TGT.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_DELTA;

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
(
CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,[Timestamp]
,PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 SRC.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId AS CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,[Timestamp] AS [Timestamp]
,PasswordEnabledIndicator AS PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator AS ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator AS ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId = SRC.CustomerOnlineBankingUserId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'



INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
(
CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,[Timestamp]
,PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 CustomerOnlineBankingUserId AS CustomerOnlineBankingUserId
,[Timestamp] AS [Timestamp]
,PasswordEnabledIndicator AS PasswordEnabledIndicator
,ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator AS ForceTransactionPasswordChangeIndicator
,ForcePasswordChangeIndicator AS ForcePasswordChangeIndicator
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerOnlineBankingUserPasswordStatus_DELTA;

END
